title: Queen vs King
summary: Learn the basic idea of using your queen and king together to force checkmate against a lone king.
objectives: Use the queen to restrict the enemy king
Bring your king closer to help

steps.title: The big idea
steps.body: Your queen is strong enough to trap the enemy king, but your own king must help finish the job.

steps.title: Do not rush checks
steps.body: Beginners often keep checking forever. First restrict the king, then bring your king closer, then deliver mate.

steps.title: Starting example
steps.coach_note: White has more than enough material. The goal is not random checks. The goal is to trap the king step by step.

steps.title: Shrink the box
steps.coach_note: A queen can cut off files, ranks, and diagonals. Think about making the enemy king's area smaller and smaller.

steps.title: What matters most?
steps.question: In queen vs king, what is the most important practical idea?
options: Trap the king and bring your king closer
steps.answer: Trap the king and bring your king closer

feedback.correct: Correct. Restriction plus king support is the winning method.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. Random checks can slow you down or even risk stalemate.

steps.title: Lesson recap
steps.body: Use the queen to limit the king, bring your king in, and watch carefully for stalemate before the final mate.
